inj.note: After Aiyuk filed his paperwork for reinstatement, San Francisco activated him from the reserve/left squad list Nov. 9. Rosenhaus noted that Aiyuk passed his physical at that time, with MRIs and X-rays on his surgically repaired knee revealing no concerns. The 49ers were granted a two-week roster exemption for Aiyuk that will expire next Monday, and the 28-year-old wideout is expected to be cut loose at that time since San Francisco seemingly hasn't expressed interested in retaining him. While it's unclear what kind of market might exist for Aiyuk's services coming off a lengthy layoff from NFL action, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz relayed earlier this month that at least one NFC team has expressed interest in adding the receiver to its practice squad.

news.h: Sources: Brandon Aiyuk contacted Jayden Daniels to mend friendship with star QB
news.d: Brandon Aiyuk and Jayden Daniels have patched up their relationship after a falling out earlier this year.
